title: Restore all G20 carry machines with 12 history bits per row
body:
The released G20 carry producer now has a complete logical forward/copy/reverse protocol. All 23 quotient components have exact inverse transitions, and all source columns return every history record and logical work register to zero while preserving the packet and a dirty output target.

The worst quotient transition has 20 predecessors, so five history bits are necessary and sufficient under its known-letter contract. The full 729-column × 512-bit-row census reduces the combined quotient/comparison bound from 13 to **12 history bits per row**. A 3,328-predecessor witness proves 12 bits sharp on the stated unrestricted product-state row domain. This is not a global minimum for initialized canonical-input producers.

Evidence: all 304,894 inverse edges, all 373,248 source-row patterns, 3,645 distinct-column/radix cases, 49,449 exhaustive active q=3 inputs, 1,472 dirty-output cases, 23 cases at 4,097 bits, invalid-input restoration and seven rejecting controls. Normal and optimized registered checks agree. Exact committed bytes/modes, 20-file official export, declared-input coverage, read-only Git-free empty-PATH normal/optimized replay and exported-source corruption rejection pass.

The explicit interface requires immutable rows available in reverse order and returns five packet bits plus one validity bit. For L rows, the logical ledger is 2L row accesses, 7L+1 table queries and at most 88L+5 table bits read. The inverse data adds **1,525,010 bytes plus 17,093 metadata/witness bytes** to the retained 464,866-byte forward table. Storage and return access are paid quantities, not free helpers.

Limits: this is a logical table-transducer construction, not a Boolean-gate or physical tape tariff. Cursor, lookup scratch, arithmetic gates and actual routing remain to be priced. It does not permit return through input rows changed by a later consumer. There is no automatic consumer substitution, physical speedup, new kappa or discharge of the five framework assumptions. Selected PR6030 is unchanged. No Lean, Docker, independent human acceptance or optional full-history preflight is claimed in this shallow checkout. No known fragile workaround is used.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-reversible-carry`.

Credit PR6474's carry invariant, PR6503's compact machines, PR5820, ToikY, Nick Petalas, Tekalign, JoyboyBrian, Kyu and the retained G20/native/ROW lineage. Reversible embeddings and predecessor ranking are classical. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Exact predecessor proofs and bytes remain in inputs.

Canonical main7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority8 and live overlap through PR6527 were rechecked before publication. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4945#discussioncomment-19365111). Next: lower a literal restored lookup to the actual tape layout and join a preserved source cache to the physical packet consumer.
